method.randomOdRule: ordered pairs of distinct stations/stops >= 2 km apart, uniform sample without replacement, each endpoint offset 150-400 m at a random bearing
method.roadLegs: offline deterministic provider (haversine x 1.2; walking 1.3 m/s)
method.database: none (demo mode: accessibility, crowd and weather from the seeded demo datasets)

variants.infrastructure: station rules + walking/rolling cap (crowd rule off)
variants.deployed: infrastructure + crowd rule, exactly as multimodalController.ts

method.softPolicy: same ranker (mlPreferenceService.rankRoutes, profile weights) over ALL candidates; a blocked route keeps accessibilityScore=0 but remains eligible
